name: vichaar-iq
description: AI-powered business intelligence platform for natural-language analytics across SQL and MongoDB.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@vichaar-iq/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@vichaar-iq/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@vichaar-iq/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@vichaar-iq/api && npm run build --workspace=@vichaar-iq/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vichaar-iq/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vichaar-iq/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@vichaar-iq/shared && npm run build --workspace=@vichaar-iq/database && npm run build --workspace=@vichaar-iq/agents
